column1: # emu-profilegen 1.2 (ProfileGenerator, ledger U1510-U1514) - identity map - bare_host - every value synthetic (RDRAND), no real value, no install-history offset
# The identity this profile presents: GENERATION (the first build, or --new-identity) drew every value from RDRAND
# (Randomize->gen_...); every later build APPLIES this map to the clean capture, byte for byte. Keys name a field location
# (environment + field id), never a value; "shared/" keys are the same in both profiles (one USB serial per physical device).
# columns: key, kind, synthetic value (final text form)
